page.overview:
What is Blackthorn City?

Blackthorn City is a city introduced in Generation II.

Blackthorn City is located in the Johto region. It has a population of 27. Its Gym Leader is Clair, who specializes in -type Pokémon and can be challenged in Blackthorn City Gym. Blackthorn City is also where the Move Tutor and the Move Deleter are located. There is also a man who will teach Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, and Hydro Cannon to the final evolution of any Starter Pokémon, and a woman who teaches Draco Meteor. As with any other city, Blackthorn City has its own Pokémon Center and Poké Mart, though the latter was given a wider variety of items available in Pokémon HeartGold Version and Pokémon SoulSilver Version. There is a body of water where some -type Pokémon can be encountered by either surfing or using a Fishing Rod.

In one of the houses, the player can trade a female Dragonair to one of the residents in exchange for a Rhydon named Don. In Pokémon Crystal Version and Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver, they receive a Dodrio named Doris instead.

The Dragon's Den was built by a clan of Dragon-type masters. It is a cavern with an underground lake and a shrine to Dragon Pokémon. Many strong trainers can be found here, and the Dragon Clan's Master will give the player a Dratini if he/she answers correctly to his questions. Silver can also be found here. Clair will come and reward the player with the Rising Badge and the TM DragonBreath after refusing to do so at the Gym.
